Siva R: Heads up — staging run (long-chat workload) shows steady RSS growth over ~30m then bursty evictions. p95 token latency climbs before the churn. My gut says KV slot fragmentation + aggressive batch-merge is creating head-of-line stalls when fragments try to reattach. Anyone seen this pattern?

Maria L: Which model/config? quantized or fp16? repro script?

Siva R: repro: `./bench_longctx.sh --model redwood-mini-8k --seq 6k --clients 120 --batch-mode continuous`
logs excerpt:
```
2024-04-28T12:34:10Z [kvcache] slot_fragments=12 reuse_hits=3 merge_attempts=42
2024-04-28T12:34:52Z [batcher] merge_size=48 head_of_line_wait_ms=320 p95=410
2024-04-28T12:35:21Z [kvcache] reclaim_evictions=128 gown_alloc=+54MB
```
Also attached a tiny flame snippet: `flame://staging/1723456789/kv-merge-wait` (perf-bot uploaded).

Perf-Bot: Profile uploaded: https://perf.redwood/internal/profiles/1723456789 (heap + cpu + kv-traces) :eyes:

Kevin: I ran into something similar last month — turned out lazy compaction + unbounded merge tokens caused large contiguous merges that blocked the slot reclaim path. Try toggling `kv.compact_mode=aggressive` or limit `batch.merge.max_size=32`.

Dora: Quick run with `batch.merge.max_size=32` vs baseline (same repro):
- baseline: p50=27ms p95=412ms rss=6.8GB merge_count=58 evict_ops=132
- max_size=32: p50=29ms p95=198ms rss=6.2GB merge_count=110 evict_ops=48
So tail improved but merge churn doubled. tradeoff. :thinking_face:

Maria L: I pushed a branch: `maria/kv-merge-guard` — adds early-exit on merge if `fragmentation_score > 8` and adds `merge_jitter_ms` to the controller. Link: https://git.redwood/repo/commit/abd1234

Siva R: Nice. Can someone run that on the longctx script? @Infra-Bot can we spin a staging job with 8x A100 and the branch applied?

Infra-Bot: Started run `staging-longctx-042` (branch: `maria/kv-merge-guard`) — logs: https://ci.redwood/builds/042 — ETA ~12m

Kevin: Also noticed kernel selection path touches the same KV tags during decode when sequence length >4k; small change in `kernel_picker` avoided doing a full `kv_tag_scan` on short-lived batches. Patch snippet:
```
- if (ctx.seq_len > 1024) scan_all_tags();
+ if (ctx.seq_len > 4096 && !batch.continuous) scan_all_tags();
```
That reduced the number of tag-promoting ops in my local repro.

Dora: Ran the infra job halfway — heap profile shows fewer long-lived fragments but alloc rate temporarily spiked during merge windows. Uploaded heap: https://perf.redwood/internal/heap/1723456789/heap1

Siva R: Proposal: combine three mitigations — tighten merge size (<=32), guard merge when fragmentation high, and add small randomized delay to concurrent shard merges. This should prevent synchronous back-to-back large merges that stall reclaimers.

Maria L: +1. I'll draft a lightweight rollout: canary the branch with `merge_jitter_ms=15` and `merge_max_concurrent_per_shard=1` then watch evict_ops and head_of_line_wait_ms.

Kevin: FYI, if we see regression in p50, we can tune `prefetch.window` to trade a bit more prefetch for fewer small merges.

Siva R: Thanks everyone. Perf-bot — can you summarize the key metrics to the ticket? I'll link everything to PERF-738. :thumbsup:

Perf-Bot: Summary posted to PERF-738: metrics (p50/p95/RSS/merge_count/evict_ops) + links to profiles and CI run.

Dora: ack, will keep experimenting with aggressive compaction on a separate branch and post numbers.

Maria L: :thumbsup: when infra finishes, we should have clear delta.
